notes: Cross-verse split in the supplied copula of a verbless clause with an adverbial predicate. 15.46 gives it to proton (is first) and 15.55 to pou (where is) under rule 53's adjective-or-adverb arm; 15.42 gave it to the subject noun anastasis citing rule 96. Rule 96 speaks of a determiner-carrying article inside the predicate phrase, and its precedent 2CO.1.7 supplies a subject ye with tes parakleseos as the predicate complement. Here he anastasis ton nekron is the subject and houtos is the only predicate, so rule 53 governs and the copula moves to the adverb.
